ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import (\\n    register_hook, get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights,\\n)\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nENSEMBLE_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / \\"factors\\" / \\"factor_ensemble.json\\"\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nMIN_WEIGHT, MAX_WEIGHT = 0.015, 0.16\\n_last_decision = None\\n\\n\\ndef _rank(values, direction=1):\\n    valid = sorted((s, direction * float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if valid:\\n        n = len(valid)\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):\\n            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef _box_simplex(raw):\\n    # Iterative capped/floored normalization; guarantees a complete target.\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed = set()\\n    for _ in range(40):\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]\\n        total_fixed = sum(w[s] for s in fixed)\\n        scale = (1.0 - 1.0\\n        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, r, str(df.iloc[-1][\\"date\\"]))\\n    if len(data) < 12:\\n        return\\n    decision = max(v[4] for v in data.values())\\n    if _last_decision is not None:\\n        try:\\n            elapsed = (np.datetime64(decision) -
